Call taker, Vale Control. Keep Ellen on line. Engine is on road, Boat 4 is en route to her after footbridge man. Advise Ellen to prepare for transfer to roof next door if water continues rising before boat arrives.
logs: Decision to redirect Boat 4 from underpass dip to footbridge man and Ellen. Decided by Boat 4 now positioned on road to dam area, man off footbridge holding post in water presents immediate drowning risk, and Ellen has water rising to ninth stair with engine arriving. Trading off Sam on van roof in dip, who flashlight stopped moving at 05:16 and Boat 7 is trapped in basin with road under water, for two immediate life threats in dam area where Boat 4 is already en route. If wrong, Sam is lost; if correct, two lives saved now.
